notes:
Image tools: Upscale images, remove objects or watermarks, repaint selections and expand images. Upscaling offers Real-ESRGAN, Upscayl weights, waifu2x, Lanczos and generative models; some weights have non-commercial licences. Managed tools and weights may need a download. Web cannot install managed tools and requires an output location in a registered project. Edits create new PNGs and leave originals unchanged.
First-launch setup: Connect online speech recognition, speech synthesis and image services instead of downloading local models, and choose the provider as the default. Semantic search and music still require local models.
Transcription and jobs: MOSS, Qwen and Whisper pipeline transcription can resume completed work after a crash or Runtime restart. Job retries retain command deduplication; pipeline progress shows the active transcription stage, and job inspection reports stage and step timings, including available remote timings. Whisper avoids incompatible Metal and CUDA GPUs; Vulkan retains its existing GPU selection.
Codex and text models: Use Codex as a text provider and choose its agent model and reasoning effort for text, translation and dubbing. Text model menus group by provider and put ready choices first; translation and dubbing remember their selections. New sessions remember the selected agent and model as defaults. Existing enabled Codex provider grants gain transcript access on reconciliation; revoked grants remain revoked. GPT-6.1 Terra is available and recommended as the Codex default when supported.
Editor and tools: Video actions and versions move into the video name menu, with background tasks shown in a progress ring. Tool actions stay visible in a sticky header; images open in the viewer and can be sent directly to image tools. Text selection and resizing follow the actual typeset block rather than an oversized box.
Captions and compositions: Installed caption fonts can load before the first cue appears; missing system CJK sans fonts use the bundled fallback without a misleading warning. Composition previews and captures are more reliable under load.
Video production: A historical recording scene template helps create a researched introduction and a subtitled original recording. Its recorded end-to-end verification was partial; bilingual subtitles needed correction after review. Updated production guidance improves legibility, visual hierarchy and subtitle layout.
Requirements and verification limits: macOS packages require Apple Silicon and macOS 14+ and are signed and notarized. Windows CPU, CUDA and Vulkan packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; GPU variants require compatible drivers. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies. Electron 44.9.3 embeds Node 24.22.0 and does not include the October Node security fixes. Automated checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, physical IME candidate windows or paid agent calls.
